_comment: Tier-2 for febio::growth_remodeling#0 — four failures from one claim, each at a different stage. Deleting <growth> or <elastic> is caught at read time and each is named; an uncoupled Mooney-Rivlin elastic child reads SUCCESS and then gives 'Elastic material should not be of type uncoupled' + 'Model initialization failed'; an unregistered type gives 'tag "material" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"'; and wrapping the material in a `solid mixture` reads SUCCESS and then dies at the first increment. That last branch FALSIFIES the claim's Signal: it does NOT report 'N negative jacobians detected.'. It reports 'Max nr of iterations reached.', then '------- failed to converge at time', 0 completed steps and error termination. The fixture asserts the negative-jacobian string is ABSENT, so the wrong Signal cannot come back. All four branches required. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'kinematic_growth_shape=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
